Markus —

Thanks, forwarding my suggested compromise below (keeps Redwood's platform improvement lifecycle intact while addressing Verdant's core asks). Inline below with clause references:

1) Output Ownership (Section 3.2)
Proposed language (short): "Customer retains ownership of Customer Data and any direct Customer Content, including trademarks and product names. Redwood is granted a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free right to use Generated Output solely to deliver the Services, to perform security and quality assurance, and to improve the Services on an aggregated, de-identified basis as set forth in Section 5.1. Such use shall not permit Redwood to claim ownership over Customer's trademarks or to sell Customer-specific models or derivatives back to third parties."

2) Feedback License (Section 5.1)
Proposed language: "Customer may opt into a Feedback License that grants Redwood a limited, non-exclusive license to use Feedback and non-PII Telemetry solely to improve the Services. Feedback shall be de-identified and aggregated, and shall not include Customer PII or any 'Confidential Customer Content' as defined in Section 1.1. The Feedback License shall not permit redistribution to third-party purchasers of model bundles containing Customer-specific data."

3) Training / Retraining (Order Form, Annex A)
Operational compromise: add an Order Form checkbox: 'Customer elects to provide data for model improvement (yes/no)'. If 'yes', add: "Data used for training will be de-identified, aggregated, and limited to improvements to the Redwood hosted service instance used by Customer; no model weights or customer-specific models will be sold or otherwise distributed to third parties."

Notes and open items:
- We should add a carveout for regulatory obligations where Verdant requires us to preserve telemetry for compliance; handle case-by-case.
- Need to confirm what Verdant considers 'Customer PII' vs 'Customer Content' — their GC may want a tighter definition.

I'll attach a redline doc (short), but high-level language above should be safe to send.

Laura

Alicia —

Thanks for the note and the annotated Order Form. We've reviewed internally and propose the following compromise language for your review (low-friction, aimed at getting GC signoff):

1) Output ownership (replacement for Section 3.2):
"Customer retains ownership of all Customer Content, including trademarks and product names. Redwood shall have a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free right to use Generated Output strictly to provide the Services, for security and QA, and to improve the Services on an aggregated and de-identified basis. Redwood will not claim ownership over Customer trademarks or sell Customer-specific models or derivatives to third parties without an additional agreement."

2) Feedback license (revised Section 5.1):
"Customer may opt into a narrow Feedback License enabling Redwood to use de-identified and aggregated Feedback and Telemetry to improve only the Services delivered to customers generally. Feedback shall not include Customer PII or any data marked as Confidential Customer Content. Redwood will not transfer or license such Feedback in a way that allows redistributing Customer-specific outputs to third-party customers."

3) Order Form Annex A (training opt-in):
Add a checkbox and short operational definition: 'Provide data for model improvement: Yes / No'. If Yes: 'Data used for training will be de-identified and aggregated; training will exclude PII and will be applied to general model improvements for the Redwood service fleet; no customer-specific model weights will be published or sold.'

Attached is a clean copy of the proposed language and a brief redline. If this looks reasonable, Laura can provide a short formal redline for your GC. If helpful, Ben and I are available for a 30-min call tomorrow at 11am PT to walk through.

Best,
Markus
